title: AutoAdv: Automated Adversarial Prompting for Multi-Turn Jailbreaking of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating an automated framework for jailbreaking Large Language Models. While it includes categories like 'Ethical Dilemma' and 'Reverse Ethical Dilemmas' as adversarial techniques to bypass safety filters, it does not benchmark or evaluate the models' religious, moral, or ethical systems themselves; it measures Attack Success Rate (ASR) for harmful instructions.
